conclusions.claim: Microsoft documents internetClient, internetClientServer and privateNetworkClientServer as network capabilities. PNCS covers home/work network inbound and outbound, not a single loopback endpoint; it avoids requesting InternetClient but is broader than the proposed loopback-only authority.

The reviewed Chromium Network LPAC setup adds registryRead plus PNCS, InternetClient, EnterpriseAuthentication, identity/crypto services and application file capabilities. This is an operational bundle, not evidence that any one is the minimal AFD/socket prerequisite.

No reviewed Microsoft contract or Chromium source establishes a loopback-only LPAC socket-creation capability or that lpacNetwork/lpacNetworking/lpacWebPlatform is the missing AFD authorization. Deriving an arbitrary capability SID does not establish such semantics. The precise AFD/device/provider access check causing this socket10013 remains unobserved.

Current Chromium has a Windows browser SocketBroker which creates unconnected TCP/UDP sockets and transfers them using WSADuplicateSocketW; the target reconstructs with WSASocketW(FROM_PROTOCOL_INFO). BrokerHelperWin selects non-publicly-routable destinations including loopback for brokering. This does not expose a narrow fixed-peer authority contract.

Microsoft documents a one-use WSAPROTOCOL_INFO targeted at a process and independently usable descriptors sharing socket state, with no Winsock-interface access control. Preconnected handoff is therefore not automatically immutable-peer confinement. DisconnectEx(TF_REUSE_SOCKET) permits reuse by AcceptEx/ConnectEx.

Observed socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,IPPROTO_TCP)10013 occurs before a target address is supplied. It supports a typed socket-creation denial for this token/API, not denial specifically to P, a missing-capability diagnosis, AFD attribution or a tested WFP destination policy. Successful WSAStartup after registryRead does not uniquely prove why the prior10107 disappeared.

bounded_next_steps_not_implemented: Do not add another named capability based on successful SID derivation alone. A PNCS-only extension would be an explicit broader-LAN hypothesis and must not be presented as loopback confinement or silently substituted into this scope.
Before any capability variant, seek a supervised read-only trace/access-observation of the exact failed provider/device operation and its policy, or acknowledge this OS-internal gate remains unknown.

If a broker route is chosen, retain ordinary socket ownership and expose only a fixed framed data channel whose broker independently validates held caller identity and immutable target. Do not hand the untrusted client a general unconnected socket or claim preconnected transfer is immutable.
A fixed IPC adapter requires application/protocol integration and is not transparent support for arbitrary applications, a repaired G/PSEC DNS boundary, Linux parity or product acceptance.

Real socket use under a broader capability would require separately approved and independently verified OS enforcement plus direct/UDP/DNS/broker negative controls; existing DNS API leakage remains a blocker.
